narrative.intro: Thalle Construction has $1.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Thalle Construction won 3 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $640M and obligations up 572.6% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations show a recent jump: FY21 was $167M, FY22 was $213M, FY23 was $16.1M, FY24 was $366M, FY25 was $285M, and FY26 is $1.9B. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, obligating $1.9B. The Department of the Interior obligated $239K. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $1.9B in obligations, while Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $239K. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). This profile shows concentration by buyer and market in FY2026 to date and a large year-over-year increase in obligations.
